verdict.rationale: incident.io's own docs say it auto-generates an incident timeline from key events and that users can edit it afterwards by adding their own narrative or external events. However, the evidence never says which events are captured, so automatic capture of alerts, actions, and chat decisions specifically is unproven, and the docs call it a "simple" timeline. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that alerts, responder actions, and Slack/Teams chat decisions are captured on the timeline; detail on annotating or editing existing auto-generated entries; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the incident timeline is captured automatically — alerts, actions, and chat decisions — and I can edit or annotate it afterwards

citations.quote: Our timeline is completely customizable. We generate a simple timeline based on key events, but you can always add your own narrative or events that happened in an external system.
you can always add your own narrative or events that happened in an external system
